posts.subject: [ENG] Changelog - 22.08.2017 || Credits + TTT Update
posts.bodyHtml:
[Bild]

--- All Server ---

- Added a plugin that gives you daily credits.
The plugin was designed by yash1441 and then reworked and extended in collaboration between @Nachtfrische and him.


It works as followed:
You go to any server and write !daily or !dailies in the chat. Then you get 75 credits. For each additional day in a row you get 25 more credits so:


Day 1: 75 credits
Day 2: 100 credits
...
Day 7: 225 credits
[Bild]


If you miss a day, your run will reset and you start again with 75 credits.
After a week of successful logging you will be automatically restarted and start again with 75 credits.


[Bild]


- A plugin that adds or extends additional admin features has been added. The original plugin was created by @Runningcore and was modified by @Nachtfrische. A more detailed description will be made in separate threat in the admin section of forum.


- A plugin that overwrites the connect message has been added. This plugin was exclusively created by @Mr. Baguette. Thanks a lot for this.


- Message from the serveradvertisement plugin has been reworked and supplemented with a different plugin.


- The original " Steam group credits " plugin was created by @Mr. Baguette and now gives an additional credits for administrators who are in the DreamTeam steam group. This gives administrators more credits.



--- TTT Server ---


- The map ttt_damons_disco_b2 has been replaced by ttt_damons_disco_b3_1. Thanks to @Damon for suggestion here.


- TTT server slot increased from 16 players to 20 players.


- A plugin that drops players who want to connect to a full server via the console has been added. This plugin was also created by @Mr. Baguette. Exceptions are, of course, administrators can still connect to the server even if it's full.


- In addition, @Mr. Baguette has designed another plugin to reduce the voice spam on TTT. The " DREAM VOICE MANAGER " plugin takes care of how much you talk in the voice chat and mutes you briefly if you voicespam too much.
If you talk for 10 seconds, all players will see that you have been muted and you will receive a message stating that you can talk again in 5 seconds. At this time you can still talk but no player will hear you on the server. Hope this will help the Voicespam get a grip on the TTT and provide a better playing experience. Thanks again @Mr. Baguette in place for the very fast development of the plugin.


- Last but not least, the last version of the TTT plugin, ie version 2.1-1179, was added to the server. @Nachtfrische has tested this over the last few days with some other admins for errors and functionalities and now finally has been Installed on both TTT servers. Highlights are new items such as Silent AWP or the knockout in the Traitorshop, as well as the removal of some bugs.
Special Thanks goes to @Bara, who tested with @Nachtfrische until late night and helped release the new updates at 3 o'clock in the night.


As always we hope you enjoy these updates and have fun on the game servers and in the community.
We look for further feedback from you.
Thank you @OxygeN for this translation.

@Bara edited.
